subject: SIG: clarification on log ephemerality and written attestation
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@medicarx.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up: log retention & training on customer data

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the SIG draft — we reviewed the answers and procurement has a couple of clarifying asks before we move to redline. Can you confirm the following in one short response we can share with legal/procurement?

1) Exact retention windows you apply to request/response logs (both full payloads and minimal metadata). Please call out defaults and options for customer-configured shorter retention.
2) Do you ever use customer request/response content to train models (ongoing weights updates or periodic fine-tuning) by default, or only with explicit customer opt-in? If opt-in, what's the opt-in flow and how do you record evidence?
3) Are prompt/KV caches persisted to disk or network storage, and if so, what is the maximum retention and how is it isolated per-customer?

We may ask for a short attestation that "Redwood Inference does not use customer data for model training without explicit written opt-in." Would you be able to provide that?

Appreciate a crisp answer — procurement is on a tight timeline.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Head of Security & Compliance
MedicaRx

--

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: log retention & training on customer data

Hannah — thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers you can share with procurement; I attached a short evidence pack and our prompt log policy for reference.

1) Retention windows (default / configurable):
- Full request/response payloads: default retention = 72 hours (ephemeral mode). Customers on enterprise plans can request shorter windows (24h) or longer windows (30 days) via configuration and contract SOW.
- Minimal operational metadata (routing, latency, token counts): default retention = 30 days; configurable down to 7 days for Dedicated/Private deployments.

2) Training on customer data:
- Default: Redwood does NOT use customer request/response content to train or update model weights. Customer content is excluded from our training pipelines unless there is an explicit, documented opt-in.
- Opt-in flow: customer signs a distinct Data Use Addendum (DUA) that references model training; opt-in is recorded in our contract system and a unique tag is added to the account (audit trail stored in our compliance DB). Training-only artifacts are stored in isolated buckets and access-controlled.

3) Prompt / KV caches:
- KV caches are kept in-memory on inference hosts and treated as ephemeral. By default they are not persisted to long-term disk. For Dedicated/Private we can enable persistent caches but they are tenant-isolated and encrypted at rest. If persisted, maximum configured retention is 30 days unless otherwise negotiated.

Additional controls:
- Encryption: customer data in transit and at rest is encrypted (TLS + AES-256). Keys can be customer-managed via KMS/HSM for Private deployments.
- Access controls & logging: all access to stored artifacts is audited; we provide audit logs for Dedicated/Private customers upon request.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; the SOC 2 report and SIG exhibits are included in the attached evidence pack.

Requested attestation: happy to provide the short written statement below as a signed PDF. Please confirm if this wording works for procurement: 

"Redwood Inference does not use customer request or response content to train models (including model fine-tuning or weight updates) unless the customer provides explicit, documented opt-in via a Data Use Addendum.

Redwood Inference treats inference-level KV caches as ephemeral by default and does not persist prompt-level data to long-term storage unless persistent caching is configured by the customer and explicitly agreed in contract."

If that wording is acceptable I will send a signed attestation PDF and the evidence package.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: sig-evidence-package.pdf (PDF stub), prompt_log_policy.md (text)
